_about: Which wiki pages to build, from which original sources, and how they link. The harness uses this file so page names stay short and stable, and re-ingesting updates the same pages instead of creating duplicates.

folders.Sessions: One page per recruiting event I attended
folders.Topics: Pages that combine what several sessions said about one subject

pages.title: Amazon MBA Info Session
pages.description: Amazon's MBA programs (ALA, FLDP, MLDP and others), interview style, and application process

related.Behavioral Interview Prep: the session explained Amazon's STAR and leadership-principle interview style
related.Tech Hiring Process: Amazon's own application steps, compared with the general tech process

pages.title: Tech Internship Panel
pages.description: Second-year MBA students on how they landed tech internships

related.Tech Networking: most panel advice was about networking with recruiters, alumni, and classmates
related.Amazon MBA Info Session: one panelist interned at AWS and described Amazon recruiting

pages.title: Tech Roles Workshop
pages.description: Career workshop on MBA roles in tech, what shapes a role, and the hiring process

related.Tech Hiring Process: the workshop listed the usual hiring steps
related.Tech Networking: the workshop gave networking questions to ask
related.Tech Resume Workshop: both sessions stress showing transferable skills

pages.title: Tech Resume Workshop
pages.description: How to rewrite resume bullets for tech roles

related.Behavioral Interview Prep: a bullet bank doubles as a story bank for interviews
related.Tech Roles Workshop: the role descriptions tell you which skills to surface

pages.title: Tech Hiring Process
pages.description: The steps from application to offer, in general and at Amazon

related.Tech Roles Workshop: source of the general hiring steps
related.Behavioral Interview Prep: how to prepare for the interview step

pages.title: Tech Networking
pages.description: Networking advice for tech recruiting from the panel and the roles workshop
